name: Newport News
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Newport News for 2026, and here is what he found: 11 family events, 6 of them free. The magic runs from November 26 (Celebration in Lights at Newport News Park) through January 1, 2027, with Port Warwick Holiday Tree Lighting (November 28), the Tree Lighting Ceremony and Holiday Drone Show (December 5), Holiday Frost: Polar Express Experience (December 11) and Let It Glow (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Newport News

  • 11 Christmas events for kids in Newport News
  • 6 free events, including the Tree Lighting Ceremony and Holiday Drone Show, Lights at the Fountain and the Port Warwick Holiday Tree Lighting
  • Meet Santa: Storytime with Santa at The Mariners' Museum on December 6 and photos with Santa at Winter Nature Nights
  • Parades and tree lightings: Port Warwick tree lighting on November 28 and the City Center tree lighting on December 5
  • Trains: train rides at the Port Warwick tree lighting and the Polar Express Experience on December 11
  • Lights: Celebration in Lights at Newport News Park and Lights at the Fountain
  • Season: November 26, 2026 to January 1, 2027

Planning a bigger day out? Newport News families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Virginia Beach, which covers holiday lights and events around the Oceanfront, Town Center and the Virginia Aquarium.
